roleLabel: Dual Warrior/Duelist tempo carry — Pirouette AoE with Crit/Omnivamp and Shard generation on autos
bestFor: Tempo boards that want Attack Speed, Shards, and a flexible martial carry
strength: Luxurious prints Shards while stacking AS/Attack; Pirouette hits everyone in range with temporary Crit/Omnivamp
weakness: Dual-class dilutes rank pools; forcing both fantasies at once can soft-lock specific upgrades

howToPlay.early: She can be your tempo carry if packs are in range. Buy Attack Speed. Do not over-invest dual-class modifiers until you know the run direction.
howToPlay.mid: Stylish = item slot + bonus damage per Shard generated. Sharp = Rush Warrior % and Stall Duelist % team buffs. Elegant/Luxurious path = AS/Shard auto engine. Pick inventory snowball, tribal martial, or personal tempo.
howToPlay.late: Feed Shards into the Stylish loop or lean Sharp when you have Warrior/Duelist friends. Fury/Outbreak Duelist pieces still help her autos.
howToPlay.positioning: Mid where Pirouette range covers the pack. She wants bodies in range, not a lonely sniper corner.

abilityNotes.Pirouette: Short Crit/Omnivamp buff then AoE in range. Attack Speed and packing enemies multiply the cast.

specNotes.The Stylish: Shard damage + item slot. Take when Shard generation is already flowing.
specNotes.The Sharp: Warrior Rush + Duelist Stall tribal amp. Take with martial friends on both tags.
specNotes.The Elegant: Luxurious tempo/Shard auto identity — default solo Tilly carry path.

relicReasons.duelists-fury-filigree-3010: AS aggression for Luxurious autos and Pirouette.
relicReasons.duelists-outbreak-banner-571: Duelist half of her dual identity.
relicReasons.martial-amplifier-2015: Glue when Warrior/Duelist specialty relics miss.

faq.question: Is Tilly good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Strong flexible tempo carry. Confusing if you chase every dual-class upgrade. Buy her for AS/Shard loops, then commit one Rank B fantasy.

faq.question: What class is Tilly?
faq.answer: Warrior / Duelist dual-class. Role focus: tempo AoE carry and Shard engine.

faq.question: What relics work with Tilly?
faq.answer: Duelist Fury/Outbreak pieces, martial amplifiers, and Rush/Stall tools for Sharp.

faq.question: How do you play Tilly?
faq.answer: Keep enemies in range, stack Attack Speed, cast Pirouette, and specialize toward Elegant tempo, Stylish Shards, or Sharp tribal.

tips: Dual-class is a tool, not a requirement — stop multiclassing if you are hunting one modifier.
Stylish without Shard income is a trap; print Shards first.
